policy.method: Independent Python Fraction, set operations and itertools enumeration
policy.finite: Nonempty nonnegative integer weights with positive sum; normalize by sum
policy.events: Zero-based outcome indices; duplicates denote the same set member
policy.complement: Complement of A in the full sample space
policy.independent: Exact P(A intersection B)=P(A)P(B), including zero-mass events
policy.percentages: Numbers in [0,100], at most two decimal places; Fraction(str(value))/100
policy.posteriorMass: Four cells in joint order, conditioned on selected evidence E; non-E cells zero; null if impossible
policy.counting: n=2..8, k=0..4; k<=n without replacement; zero-based lexicographic tuples
policy.unorderedReplacement: Counts multisets only; no claim that multisets are equiprobable
